purpose: Teach: いきさつ/参列/次女/釧路/憂慮/を以て/綴り/かんがみ

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者の発症のいきさつを医療チームで丁寧に伺います
lines.en: Ren, our medical team will listen carefully to the patient's medical history and how the condition developed.
lines.style: Direct but unhurried. Clinical precision held in a steady voice. No inflation of emotion—the weight of competence instead. Even pace, held eye contact.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、お亡くなりになった患者様の葬儀への参列を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, our medical team will attend the funeral of the patient who has passed.
lines.style: Factual statement delivered with quiet respect. A slight pause before the difficult word. No apology in the voice, but acknowledgment of solemnity.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様のご家族、特に次女様への説明を医療チームで丁寧におこないます
lines.en: Ren, our medical team will explain things carefully to the patient's family—especially to his younger daughter.
lines.style: Deliberate and measured. The emphasis on 'carefully' carries real weight—not a hollow reassurance. Steady, grounded tone. A promise held in the phrasing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 釧路医療圏との連携を、貴院、深められてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital has deepened its coordination with the Kushiro medical region, hasn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Observant, almost thoughtful. Not quite a question—more of a gentle acknowledgment phrased as one. Ren noticing something true. Soft, genuine curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、感染拡大への憂慮を医療チームで共有します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team shares concerns about the spread of infection.
lines.style: Spoken with gravity but without alarm. The clinical restraint of someone who names a serious thing plainly. Measured breath. Honest rather than reassuring.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、紙のカルテを以て長期管理してきた歴史を医療チームで尊重します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team respects the history of long-term care we've maintained using paper records.
lines.style: A moment of recognition in the voice. Not defensive—proud of the care taken, of continuity. Slight warmth beneath the professional register. Acknowledging what was done well.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様のお名前の綴りを医療チームで正確に管理します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team manages the correct spelling of the patient's name with precision.
lines.style: Precise and deliberate. Each word carries its own weight. The smallest details matter—and the voice knows it. No rush. Quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 過去の症例にかんがみて、貴院、慎重に判断されますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital takes very careful decisions in light of those previous cases, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful acknowledgment of caution earned through experience. Ren recognizing something he respects. Quieter at the end—not quite a question, more an observation offered gently.
